author: RosieCampbell
text:
A few things I'm thinking about:
- Gaps in AGI safety and policy
- Raising literacy on AI risks and impacts through storytelling
- Limitations of evals
- AI moral patienthood
- AI and epistemics
- Mechanism design
- Metascience

Let me know if you have thoughts on these!

author: RosieCampbell
text:
This was my last week at OpenAI after ~3.5 years. I worked on API safety and then transitioned to Policy Research where I worked closely with @Miles_Brundage on AI governance, frontier policy issues, and AGI readiness.

As is tradition, here’s the message I shared on Slack: https://t.co/iodYA4miJT

author: RosieCampbell
text:
I regret not freezing my eggs earlier. I think I also regret not donating my eggs.

I'm still not sure I want kids, but I wish I'd known that declining egg quality after ~35 was the main factor in fertility.

If you're on the fence I would be happy to chat
